nodes.label: MemoryNote
nodes.text: Reusable fraud-investigation pattern: When three or more distinct cards are used at the same physical terminal in a short sequence and later generate separate fraud disputes, retain the terminal as a likely common exposure point, but classify the inference as cohort/temporal evidence. Do not attribute a later fraud transaction to that merchant or terminal without a direct transaction-level VIA_TERMINAL/AT_MERCHANT or processor/merchant record; a prior purchase by the same card is contextual history only. This pattern remains valid unless direct evidence or a contrary cohort result changes it.

nodes.label: MemoryNote
